fullstackcrew-alpha-privacy-mask-privacy.description: Mask, redact and anonymize sensitive information (PII) in screenshots and images — phone numbers, emails, IDs, API keys, crypto wallets, credit cards, passwords, and more. 100% local, 100% offline. Uses OCR with 47 regex rules and optional NER. Use when receiving screenshots that may contain private data, or when the user mentions privacy/masking/脱敏/打码.
